name: agnews_coteaching_development_protocol_v1
scope: strong compatible noisy-label baseline on finite-label AG News; development-only
primary_metric: Co-Teaching ensemble constrained-label accuracy versus naive accuracy
analysis: Holm correction over six contaminated family-by-condition contrasts; clean differences are safety audits
claim_boundary: Co-Teaching receives the true total contamination fraction as its forget rate and uses two complete client backbones/adapters. The joint off-task condition extends beyond its original finite-label-noise assumption.
delora_boundary: A faithful Delora run additionally requires GPT-4o positive-set construction and relabeling; no substituted local model is reported under the Delora name.
